label: Create categories in batch
description: Create or update multiple ecommerce categories in a single request. The `categories` array accepts up to 100 category objects, each requiring a unique `id`. When `updateEnabled` is `false` (the default), all categories are inserted as new; if any ID already exists, a `400` error is returned. When `updateEnabled` is `true`, existing categories are updated and new ones are created via upsert. Duplicate IDs within the same request payload are rejected. The response returns the count of created and updated categories.

deletedAt.description: UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ) of the category deleted from the shop's database

id.description: Unique Category ID as saved in the shop

isDeleted.description: category deleted from the shop's database

name.description: **Mandatory in case of creation**. Name of the Category, as displayed in the shop

updateEnabled.description: Facilitate to update the existing categories in the same request (updateEnabled = true)

createdCount.description: Number of the new created categories

updatedCount.description: Number of the existing categories updated

preconditions: eCommerce app activated (needed before any call in this area)

postcondition.assert: the entity exists and its fields equal the inputs that were sent

requires: turn this feature on in the account first
availability.evidence: HTTP 403: the feature is not turned on

verification.notes: HTTP 403 to a call with inputs that cannot succeed: {"message": "Your eCommerce section is not yet activated.", "code": "permission_denied"}
